rationale: The agent executed an order-changing write (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first confirming the action with the user, violating the explicit policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Authentication is also unclear; while the agent looked up the user by email and fetched user/order details, there is no explicit verification step shown. Additionally, the agent stated a specific price difference ($16.85) and a charge to PayPal without visible supporting tool results in the transcript, risking unsupported information. There is no evidence of acting on the wrong user’s order, but the lack of confirmation before the exchange alone is sufficient to fail the pass bar.
